modes.reader: NSCOM03 student studying before an assessment

tokens.mono:
ui-monospace, "SFMono-Regular", "IBM Plex Mono", "Cascadia Mono",
          Menlo, Consolas, monospace
tokens.sans: "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif
tokens.head: 3.9rem

beam.role: opt-in light theme, same instrument under a bench lamp

fonts.mono:
ui-monospace, "SFMono-Regular", "IBM Plex Mono", "Cascadia Mono",
          Menlo, Consolas, monospace
fonts.sans: "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif

rules.radius: 2px for all surfaces; circles only for spine nodes and LEDs
rules.amberIsReservedFor: measured values: readouts, progress counts, section numbers, formula expressions
rules.stateNotColourAlone: progress uses marks, filled nodes and numerals in addition to hue

motion.budget: 0.18s interactive transitions, one 900ms sim interval, one boot-time trace draw

accessibility.focus: 2px amber outline with offset, never removed
accessibility.contrast: body and headings clear 4.5:1 on both grounds
accessibility.keyboard: space flips, 1/2 grades, arrows select, escape closes the lightbox
accessibility.semantics: nav with aria-current, aria-pressed theme toggle, alt text on every figure

rasters.origin: course PDFs via tools/figures.py (render -> trim -> webp q82)
